handoff: Approve: findPullRequests on gh/glab/FakeRemote with a contract case, sync makes one PR call per kind of story, mergedByAncestry bounded; golden and observe snapshots unchanged; unit tier and typecheck green. 3 minor findings: speed-up not measured vs #78, gh api graphql host on GHE unverified, GitLab GraphQL query only run against the scripted CLI.

findings.title: No measurement against #78's timings
findings.detail:
Spec Wanted: 'noop ticks measurably under today's floor ... Measure against #78's per-phase timings once it lands.' The handoff says it was not measured. Nobody can check the speed-up, so it is not a code defect.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Put one sync tick and one noop tick's TickTiming (before/after) in the PR evidence.

findings.title: gh api graphql may use the default host, not the repo's, on GitHub Enterprise
findings.detail:
findPullRequest used `gh pr list`, which resolves the host from the checkout's git remote. findPullRequests uses `gh api graphql` with {owner}/{repo} placeholders and no --hostname, so on a GHE checkout it may query the default host. Not verified: the factory never sets opts.repo, and this path was only tried live on github.com.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Check on a GHE checkout, or pass --hostname from the resolved repo.

findings.title: GitLab GraphQL query has not run against a real GitLab
findings.detail:
mrsQuery and restMr have only run against scriptedGlab. A field name or enum casing that is wrong (e.g. state, iid as a string, draft) would break every glab sync, not a single story.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Run it once against gitlab.com, or record a real answer as a fixture.
